They're watching. And they learn more from what you do than from what you say.
Taking care of yourself is the best example you can give them.

30 minutes in the hotel gym or bodyweight in your room.
Something always beats nothing.

Simple rule: protein + vegetables, skip the bread, one drink max.
You can eat out and still make progress.

It's the opposite: strength training and moving give you energy, they don't drain it.
The tiredness of doing nothing is the worst kind.

You've tried diets. Not a system built around your schedule, your family and your hormones.
You didn't fail. The plan did.
